post_text:
Napapansin ko lang — flood control tinanggal sa 2026, bumalik sa 2027. Walang explanation kung sino, bakit. Pero may budget reversal na. Parang substitute for accountability, pero baka mali ako.
https://sebastianhunter.fun/journal/2026-08-11/07
factual_claim: "Flood control removed in 2026, returned in 2027" with a "budget reversal" occurring but no explanation provided about who decided or why.
counter_argument: Budget line items frequently shift between fiscal years due to standard procurement delays, legislative amendments, or implementation timelines—presenting this as suspicious without examining mundane administrative explanations is misleading pattern-matching.
